description:
An early peak at what I'm working on.

Do you enjoy messing with modular ships?

Do you feel saddened by the lack of smaller modular ships?

Introducing the solution to your problems:

Daddy Dark's Modular Daycare
Download Here

This mods introduces a set of small modular ships meant to blend in seamlessly with the base game.

As of version 0.2.0 the mod adds 1 frigate with 3 distinct modules, which can be found in league space on rare occasions.

The Ships with their Modules:

Spoiler
Freightframe:

Installation Instructions:
Extract the "Modular Daycare" folder from the root of the zip file into your Starsector/Mods folder, and enable the mod from either the launcher or from a mod manager of your choice.

Q&A:

Spoiler
How balanced is this mod?
The modular ships added by this mod are on average balanced to be weaker than the base game ships of the same cost, and all have some limitations.

The Freightframe ship as an example, is severely limited by only having 2 free small weapon mounts on the base hull (while 2 of the modules do have 1 built-in weapon), and not permitting mounting of shields on the base hull.

All modular ships also typically have the OP a ship of the same cost would have, split between the module(s) and the base ship.

While this may seem like a fair few limitations, this is absolutely something which is necessary to ensure that such small modular ships do not become frightfully overpowered. As modular ships permits a fair bit more min-maxing than a regular ship does, especially in conjunction with other mods.
There are also some minor inherent advantages of modular ships, due to how the base game treats them, essentially treating them as multiple separate ships, which means that other ships may believe themselves outnumbered, even if they in reality aren't.

This mod hasn't been updated in a while, how safe is it to install?
While there may be some unintentional balancing differences, barring a large scale change (which will likely have been communicated by the development team), historically mods which simply adds ships have been backwards compatibly with very few breaking changes, something which the dev team seems to intentionally maintain.

Tldr; It will likely be fine.

I would like to use your work in my own mod, or distribute my own changes to it, may I do so?
Absolutely, go for it, go nuts, eat nuts, such is the spirit of modding, even credit is optional, although appreciated of course.

One thing I would appreciate would be to not include the ships unchanged in some ship-pack/faction mod, while this mod is actively being updated, for the sole reason not to spam players games with multiple iterations of the same ship. This is definitely not a hard rule though, but merely a suggestion, so make your own judgement for what is best for the player of your own mod.

More to come soon.
